mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.head, r.introduce, r.student_id, r.release_date_time, cover.file_url AS cover_url, f.file_url AS file_url, f.original_name AS file_name, f.object_name AS object_name, s.name AS student_name, avatar.file_url AS avatar FROM resources r LEFT JOIN student_file cover ON cover.id = r.student_file_cover_id LEFT JOIN student_file f ON f.id = r.student_file_file_id LEFT JOIN it_student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_file avatar ON avatar.id = s.avatar_id ORDER BY r.release_date_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.head, r.introduce, r.release_date_time, cover.file_url AS cover_url FROM resources r LEFT JOIN student_file cover ON cover.id = r.student_file_cover_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY r.release_date_time DESC
